description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Token_Text class, which represents text tokens in the HTMLPurifier library, handling character data and whitespace detection within the tokenization process.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Text
classes.description: A class representing a text token in the HTMLPurifier tokenization process, capable of storing text data, whitespace status, and producing a node representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the text token with data, determines if it consists of whitespace, and optionally accepts line and column information.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Converts the token to its corresponding node representation, including whitespace status and positional info.
